mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_user_ack (id, user_id, message_type, target_id, last_acked_id, update_time) VALUES (#{ack.id}, #{ack.userId}, #{ack.messageType}, #{ack.targetId}, #{ack.lastAckedId}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE last_acked_id = IF(last_acked_id < VALUES(last_acked_id), VALUES(last_acked_id), last_acked_id), update_time = NOW()
